Meredith Gaston Masnata

Author, Artist, Wellness Coach and Speaker

Meredith Gaston Masnata is an internationally acclaimed author, artist, wellness coach and teacher celebrating mindful, joyous and spirited living in a modern world. Meredith’s thirteen illustrated books are portable works of art, inspired by foundational principles for cultivating true wellbeing.

Meredith graduated from The University of Sydney, majoring in Art History and Theory and Gender and Cultural Studies. Continuing her education as an Integrative Nutrition Health Coach through IIN, New York, Meredith frequently features in the media and is a regular guest on ABC Radio. She presents passionately across educational and corporate spheres, inspiring wellbeing in daily life. Her lovingly illustrated books are translated into foreign languages, her artworks exhibited and collected worldwide.

Meredith savours a contemplative and richly creative life on the beautiful east coast of Australia with her husband, photographer Roberto Masnata, and their daughter, Imperia. Meredith regularly facilitates inspirational ‘Watercolour and Wellbeing Workshops’, welcoming participants of all ages and stages to celebrate the joy of art and life.
